decisions: Whole batch succeeds or fails. Ship/cancel lock the same batch row before checking/updating; shipped order blocks all cancellation. Repeated cancel returns duplicate with no inventory delta. Transaction entry owns connection and commit.
assumptions: Synthetic fixture policy frozen for the narrowed slice, not invented user approval for production.
pending: H2 is not PostgreSQL. JDK Proxy is not Spring AOP: Spring self-invocation, propagation configuration and connection-pool exhaustion remain unmeasured. One fixture batch; no production lock/load calibration.
approval_status: No external policy owner consultation claimed
